about.title: About Me
about.content:
I am a self-taught software engineer with a proven track record of building complex, high-performance web and mobile applications. My experience spans real-time systems, 3D/AR technology, and scalable backend infrastructure, including revenue share platforms with automated payouts and race management systems handling multiple real-time updates per second.


I excel at owning entire project lifecycles while delivering measurable results, such as achieving 500% build time improvements through strategic system migrations. I focus on translating business requirements into robust technical solutions that balance user needs with technical excellence.

timeline.title: Developer Technologist @ Eklipx
bullets: Architected and built an article view tracking system, including an analytics dashboard for authors with time series graphs and summary metrics.
Led the development of a revenue share calculation system, including logic implementation and PDF export functionality. Uses Stripe to make payouts to authors.
Implemented an end-to-end search experience using Meilisearch, syncing content from Strapi CMS with indexed documents and integrating front-end query functionality.
Developed and maintained an email notification system for subscribers to our Intelligence platform.
Introduced a Cypress end-to-end test suite covering all critical user flows, fully integrated into the Azure DevOps pipeline.
Gradually overhauled and modernised our Intelligence platform, improving maintainability, performance, and user experience.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer @ We Are Sweet
bullets: Led migration from self-hosted TeamCity build system to GitHub Workflows, achieving 500% reduction in build times and decreased monthly infrastructure costs.

Developed front-end interface and race control system for cutting-edge second-screen app used by endurance sports organization, handling multiple real-time updates per second while maintaining optimal performance.
Built real-time race logistics management system integrating RFID chip timing and GPS data to deliver superior accuracy and reliability over multi-day events compared to competitor solutions.
Ensured cross-platform compatibility and optimal performance across mobile and desktop devices to maintain accessibility for diverse user base.
Contributed to AWS infrastructure development with focus on security and scalability to support high-volume live data processing.

timeline.title: Front End Developer @ Engine Creative
bullets: Independently developed innovative 3D product viewer using React and 3D/AR technology, enabling users to visualise products in their own space before purchasing.
Designed white-label solution with customizable branding, allowing easy adaptation of color schemes and logos for different client requirements.
Integrated advanced 3D/AR rendering and interaction capabilities to create immersive product preview experiences that enhanced user engagement.
Led complete project lifecycle from concept to deployment as sole developer, managing all aspects of development, testing, and client delivery.
Built and maintained WordPress websites and custom plugins tailored to specific client needs and requirements.
